papers.title: Knowledge-Transfer based Cost-effective Search for Interface Structures: A Case Study on fcc-Al [110] Tilt Grain Boundary
papers.abstract: Determining the atomic configuration of an interface is one of the most important issues in materials science research. Although theoretical simulations are effective tools, an exhaustive search is computationally prohibitive due to the high degrees of freedom of the interface structure. In the interface structure search, multiple energy surfaces created by a variety of orientation angles need to be explored, and the necessary computational costs for different angles vary substantially owing to significant variations in the supercell sizes. In this paper, we introduce two machine-learning concepts, called transfer learning and cost-sensitive search, to the interface-structure search. As a case study, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our method, called cost-sensitive multi-task Bayesian optimization (CMB), using the fcc-Al [110] tilt grain boundary. Four microscopic parameters, the three-dimensional rigid body translation, and the number of atomic columns, are optimized by transferring knowledge of energy surfaces among different orientation angles. We show that transferring knowledge of different energy surfaces can accelerate the structure search, and that considering the cost variations further improves the total efficiency.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用迁移学习和贝叶斯优化加速材料界面结构搜索，对于生物力学或植入物设计中昂贵仿真的高效优化具有潜在的迁移价值。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, lacks uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or any biomechanics/implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低不同取向角度下界面结构搜索的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出成本敏感的多任务贝叶斯优化（CMB），利用迁移学习传递能量曲面知识
summary_zh.result: 知识迁移加速了结构搜索，考虑成本差异进一步提高了整体效率
summary_zh.validation: 在fcc-Al晶界案例上验证了方法的有效性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of searching interface atomic structures by leveraging knowledge across different orientation angles.
summary_en.method: A cost-sensitive multi-task Bayesian optimization framework that transfers learned energy surfaces among tasks.
summary_en.result: Transferring knowledge accelerates the structure search and accounting for cost variations further improves overall efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated with a case study on fcc-Al [110] tilt grain boundary.

papers.title: Fatigue of AlSi10Mg specimens fabricated by additive manufacturing selective laser melting (AM-SLM)
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, P.O.B. 653, Beer-Sheva 8410501, Israel

corresponding_authors.name: N. Frage
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Engineering, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, P.O.B. 653, Beer-Sheva 8410501, Israel

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了非生物医用铝合金AlSi10Mg的疲劳性能，未涉及生物医学植入物的应力遮挡或多孔结构。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration, and uses a non-biocompatible aluminum alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究选区激光熔化AlSi10Mg合金的疲劳行为。
summary_zh.method: 制备标准疲劳试样并进行轴向疲劳测试。
summary_zh.result: 获得了材料的S-N曲线及疲劳极限。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学试验验证疲劳性能。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the fatigue behavior of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Standard fatigue specimens were fabricated and subjected to axial fatigue testing.
summary_en.result: The S-N curves and fatigue limits of the material were obtained.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical fatigue tests.

papers.title: Allogeneic Red Blood Cell Transfusion Following the Total Hip Arthroplasty Triggers the Immunomodulatory Responses
papers.first_author_affiliation: Blood Transfusion Research Center, High Institute for Research and Education in Transfusion Medicine, Tehran, Iran

corresponding_authors.name: Mahdi Ghorbani
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Blood Transfusion Research Center, High Institute for Research and Education in Transfusion Medicine, Tehran, Iran

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究髋关节置换术后输血引起的免疫调节反应，与髋关节植入物生物力学方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on immunological responses to blood transfusion after THA, with no biomechanical modeling, implant mechanics, stress shielding, or micromotion analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究全髋关节置换术后输血对免疫反应的影响
summary_zh.method: 收集临床数据，比较输血与未输血患者的免疫指标
summary_zh.result: 输血引发显著的免疫调节变化
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床患者数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the immunomodulatory effects of allogeneic red blood cell transfusion after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Clinical data were collected and immune markers were compared between transfused and non-transfused patients.
summary_en.validation: Validation based on clinical patient data.
